blocks.content: Webpages are viewed on different devices—smartphones, tablets, and computers. But by default, web pages don't automatically adjust to fit various screen sizes, making them look awkward on certain devices.
Let's run the code from our last project to see what happens when we view a webpage without responsiveness.
